items.title: Is STERIS (STE) A Bargain After Its $600 Million Chemistries Expansion?
items.summary: STERIS (STE) has drawn fresh attention after committing US$600 million to a new formulated chemistries Center of Excellence in North Carolina, a major manufacturing shift that consolidates production and distribution on a single campus. See our latest analysis for STERIS. Against this backdrop, STERIS shares have risen 9.11% over the past month and 8.90% over the past quarter. The 1 year total shareholder return of 6.32% points to steadier long term compounding and suggests recent momentum...
